linkedin.text:
🚨 Your AI code agent just shipped another page that looks exactly like every other AI-built site.

You've seen it: the same hero layout, the same gradient buttons, the same feature grid. Every AI tool was trained on the same templates, so they all output the same design fingerprint.

🛠️ Hallmark is a design skill for Claude Code, Cursor, and Codex that refuses to look AI-generated.

It runs 57 anti-slop gates before letting your agent ship a page. It picks one of twenty themes (or builds a custom one), applies a macrostructure that fits your brief, and refuses the on-distribution defaults every LLM was trained into.

✅ What you get:
• Pages that feel like different designers made them, not color-swaps
• Audit existing code against AI slop patterns
• Study sites you admire and extract their design DNA

⭐ 19,240 stars on GitHub because it fixes the thing everyone hates about AI-generated UI.

Two pages by Hallmark for two different briefs feel like different sites. Same tool, different creative fingerprint every time.

🚀 Search "Nutlope hallmark" on GitHub to add it to your AI coding agent.

What's the most obvious AI slop pattern you've seen lately?
